prompt: Build an 8-qubit circuit that prepares the W state: an equal superposition of every computational basis state with exactly one qubit in |1> and the rest in |0>, i.e. (|00000001> + |00000010> + |00000100> + |00001000> + |00010000> + |00100000> + |01000000> + |10000000>) / sqrt(8), up to global phase.
